fields.description: V01PAK DHL Paket and V62KP DHL Kleinpaket ship within Germany; V53WPAK DHL Paket International and V66WPI Warenpost International ship to other EU countries.
fields.label: Product

fields.description: Two-character contract participation (Teilnahme) from the DHL contract, e.g. 01. The billing number is EKP + procedure of the product + participation.
fields.label: Participation

fields.description: Leave empty to use this row for every destination the product serves. A row for a specific country takes precedence.
fields.label: Destination Country

fields.description: Upper weight limit of this price tier per parcel. 0 means the product's own limit.
fields.label: Max Weight (kg)

fields.description: Contract net price per parcel, used for the rate list and the shipment amount. DHL's shipping API returns no prices.
fields.label: Net Price per Parcel
